name: Sticky rice
summary: Sticky rice that comes with the homestay meal in Pom Coọng and the Thai villages. Guests eat it with grilled fish and pork skewers with mắc khén.
origin: The Phú Thọ tourism list, the Pom Coọng account in Báo Phú Thọ, and a guest meal in the same paper.
howToEat: At the homestay, with grilled fish and pork skewers with mắc khén.
where: Pom Coọng and the Thai villages.
seoTitle: Xoi nep in Mai Chau — sticky rice at the homestay
seoDescription: Xôi nếp is the sticky rice of the Mai Châu homestay meal, eaten with grilled fish and pork skewers with mắc khén.
